data.source: NYC Open Data h9gi-nx95, re-downloaded 2026-11-03 with aligned columns

target: share of injury-or-fatal crashes whose recorded contributing factors include the group
inputs: area (2020 NTA or borough of the H3 cell)

gate_rules.beats_city_constant: test log-loss below one citywide share
gate_rules.area_beats_time_only: an area level is kept only if it beats time-only on test
